name: The Paper Aisle
description: A mobile-first bridal invitation-card studio template built for DIY wedding invitations: ivory, blush, and champagne-gold surfaces, an elegant Cormorant Garamond display serif, a hand-drawn stationery logo, and SVG-only artwork. Features an announcement ribbon with live save-the-date guest counter, a hero with a compact countdown timer and stylized wax-seal emblem, a card studio grid of four invitation designs with palette and mood badges, animated count-up statistics, and the signature Save-the-Date centerpiece with a big threading countdown, a validated save-the-date form (loading, success, and duplicate states), a persisted guest counter, and an add-to-my-calendar export with a clipboard fallback. Includes atelier help cards, share tools, scroll-reveal animations, mobile drawer navigation, a sticky mobile Save bar, reduced-motion support, and complete data-fws-slot content annotations.
features: announcement ribbon with cycling season notes, live guest counter, pause, and dismiss
sticky navigation with Save-the-Date CTA and mobile drawer
hero with compact countdown, status chip, and wax-seal emblem
card studio grid of four invitation designs with palette and mood badges
Save-the-Date centerpiece with threading countdown (days / hours / minutes / seconds)
validated save-the-date form with loading, success, and duplicate-email states
persisted guest counter with social-proof avatar stack
add-to-my-calendar export with clipboard fallback for older phones
atelier help cards and share tools
toast notifications, mobile Save bar, and back-to-top
fully customizable content via data-fws-slot attributes
